keyEvents.text: Goal! Stafford Rangers 1, Grimsby Town 0. Darrhyl Mason (Stafford Rangers) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Jack Birch.
Bebeto António Gomes (Stafford Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Mark Shelton (Grimsby Town).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Stafford Rangers 2, Grimsby Town 0. Jack Birch (Stafford Rangers) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal.
Cameron McJannet (Grimsby Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Grimsby Town. Jamie Walker replaces Finlay Cartwright.
Substitution, Grimsby Town. Justin Amaluzor replaces Charles Vernam.
Second Half begins Stafford Rangers 2, Grimsby Town 0.
